f.red[0].beh: Aggression: hitting, kicking or head-butting an adult or peer with enough force to be heard or to move the person; includes attempts blocked by staff. Not: brushing past, tapping to get attention.
f.red[0].cur: 0.31 per minute (EA-1 escape condition; DD-1 18.6 per hour class days)
f.red[0].ctx: Self-contained ESE classroom, 8 students, 1 teacher, 2 paraprofessionals
f.red[0].meth: a frequency count in every session, recorded on DD-1 by the classroom staff
f.acq[1].beh: ask for a break (in words, with a sign or with the break card) and go to the break area
f.acq[1].cond: an instructional demand presented and the break card within reach
f.acq[1].crit: independently, before any problem behavior, in at least 90% of opportunities
f.acq[1].meth: trial-by-trial data on Form SA-1 (independent, prompted, or problem behavior first)
f.acq[1].note: From the objective bank: Ask for a break from work (Carr & Durand, 1985; Lalli et al., 1995; Hagopian et al., 1998; Tiger et al., 2008; Hanley et al., 2001; Volkert et al., 2009; Harding et al., 2009; Geiger et al., 2010; Caruthers et al., 2015).
